dog.description_text:
Meet Olive, a truly unforgettable pup with a big personality packed into one very special dog. With just one eye, Olive has a look that turns heads everywhere she goes, but it is her personality that really makes her shine.

Olive is smart, sweet, energetic, and wonderfully silly. She brings a playful, joyful energy into every room and loves making people laugh. Attention is her favorite thing, and she is happiest when she is surrounded by her people. She would thrive in a home where she can be the center of it all, soaking up love, joining in on every activity, and being part of the action.

She is great with kids and has a natural love for people. Olive is friendly, but can be just a little cautious when meeting someone new. Olive is also leash trained and potty trained.

Olive also has the cutest little habits that make her even more lovable. She goes crazy for peanut butter, gets excited when you add ice to her water, and loves stretching out in the sun for a good sunbathing session.

Olive is looking for a home that will embrace her big personality and give her the attention she craves. In return, she will be a loyal, entertaining, and deeply loving companion who will always keep life interesting. Please fill out and submit an adoption application today.
dog.name: Olive
